name: Whipping Cream
siboNotes: While lower in lactose than milk, whipping cream can still trigger symptoms in lactose-sensitive individuals. Start with small amounts during SIBO treatment.
preparationTips: Use lactase enzyme drops if lactose sensitive
Whip just before serving to maintain texture
Store properly refrigerated to prevent spoilage
Consider using in small amounts as flavor enhancer rather than main ingredient
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in fat-soluble vitamins A and D
